title: Lost board connection reported as such, not as a heater error first (Klipper 46912431)
note: A heater keeps its last temperature for 7 s instead of 5 s without new readings, so on a full board communication loss (e.g. a QIDI Box unplugged) Klipper reports the lost board before verify_heater reports a heating error. Upstream by Kevin O'Connor (2025-07-19).
